summary: Faz 3 ICAO Biyometrik Uygunluk — frontend-only test on /admin/vesikalik → Tekli. Login OK, real headshot upload OK, ICAO Kontrol button present + enabled + wired. face-api tinyFaceDetector model manifest DOES load from jsdelivr CDN (HTTP 200 probed). HOWEVER checkIcao() fails inside the sandbox because @tensorflow/tfjs cannot initialize any backend: 'Initialization of backend webgl failed / WebGL is not supported on this device' AND 'wasm streaming compile failed: Incorrect response MIME type. Expected application/wasm' → 'Initialization of backend wasm failed'. The runIcao() catch fires the Turkish toast 'ICAO kontrolü yapılamadı' (captured via MutationObserver). Consequently icao-panel + icao-badge-* never mount in this environment for either the positive or the negative path. Per the reviewer's env-fallback clause, confirmed wiring + graceful failure + Turkish messaging + regression intact.

integration_issues.issue: icao-panel never renders in the automation sandbox. Root cause is NOT the code — TFJS (dependency of @vladmandic/face-api) cannot initialize any backend in the preview headless browser: WebGL context creation fails (no GPU) AND the wasm binary is served with wrong MIME (server returns HTML for /static/js/tfjs-backend-wasm-*.wasm). checkIcao() therefore throws and the UI correctly toasts 'ICAO kontrolü yapılamadı', but the icao-panel state stays null so no badges (icao-badge-ratio/eyes/tilt/center/bg/face) can be asserted. Confirmed by CDN probe (face-api model manifest returns 200 OK) so this is a runtime tfjs backend problem, not a model-loading problem.

5 checks (ratio, eyes, tilt, center, bg) return {key,label,ok} with Turkish labels — matches spec.
Background check uses getImageData in a try/catch to tolerate tainted canvases — good.
Thresholds are reasonable (ratio 0.62-0.88 for ~72% target, EAR<0.17 for closed eyes, tilt>7°, center offset>0.12, bg diff>28 or dark<150).
AdminPassportPhoto.runIcao: Wired correctly: sets icaoRunning, draws single canvas, calls checkIcao, sets icao state, toasts on error, resets running in finally.
UI panel renders under icao != null with correct data-testid='icao-panel' and per-check data-testid='icao-badge-{key}'.
Summary line renders TAMAM / Dikkat gerekiyor as spec'd.
concerns: When checkIcao throws (as in this sandbox), the user only sees a generic toast — consider surfacing the underlying reason (e.g., 'Model yüklenemedi / tarayıcı desteklemiyor') so operators know it's not a photo-quality issue.
AdminPassportPhoto.jsx is now ~1300 lines. Consider extracting IcaoPanel component.

action_items: No code changes required — Faz 3 ICAO wiring, Turkish messaging, panel structure and no-face fallback ARE correctly implemented per the source. The badge rendering could not be visually asserted in the automation sandbox because @tensorflow/tfjs cannot initialize any backend (no WebGL, and the app's static server returns HTML for the tfjs-backend-wasm .wasm URL). Recommend main agent verify manually in a real browser (screenshot the icao-panel with the same Unsplash headshot) OR add a friendlier error message that distinguishes 'tarayıcınız desteklemiyor' from generic failures.

OPTIONAL server hardening (unrelated to this Faz): configure the frontend static host to serve .wasm files with Content-Type application/wasm so tfjs wasm fallback works when WebGL is unavailable (currently 404 → SPA index.html breaks wasm compile).
OPTIONAL UX: in runIcao catch, use e.message or a detection of loadFaceModels failure to show a more specific Turkish toast.
critical_code_review_comments: checkIcao is a good, focused helper (~70 LOC) — clean.
AdminPassportPhoto.jsx > 1300 LOC — overdue for a split (UniformLibrary + IcaoPanel + PrintControls at minimum).
runIcao's error toast is too generic; when tfjs backend init fails users can't self-diagnose.

success_rate.frontend: Wiring+regression 100% (5/5), badge visual assertion BLOCKED by sandbox tfjs backend absence (0/2)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Faz 3 ICAO feature CANNOT be visually verified in this automation preview because face-api's tfjs runtime requires WebGL or a properly-served WASM binary — neither is available here. The model files themselves DO load (probed 200 OK). Wiring, button state, error toast Turkish text, panel data-testids in source, and full regression are verified. If retesting, either (a) run manually in a real Chromium with WebGL, or (b) mock @vladmandic/face-api via jest/playwright script injection to force a resolved detection result, or (c) fix static server MIME so tfjs-backend-wasm can init. Otherwise the icao-panel will always fail to render in this env, regardless of code correctness.
rca of the issue: checkIcao(canvasEl) → loadFaceModels() → faceapi.nets.tinyFaceDetector.loadFromUri(CDN). Manifest fetch works (200). Then faceapi.detectSingleFace(canvasEl, TinyFaceDetectorOptions).withFaceLandmarks() runs the model, which requires a tfjs backend. Sandbox chromium: (1) WebGL context creation returns null → 'WebGL is not supported on this device' → webgl backend rejected. (2) tfjs-backend-wasm requests /static/js/tfjs-backend-wasm-*.wasm; the frontend static server returns index.html (HTML, not application/wasm) → WebAssembly.instantiate CompileError → wasm backend rejected. No backend available → tfjs makeTensor throws → checkIcao rejects → runIcao catch shows 'ICAO kontrolü yapılamadı' toast. React state icao stays null → icao-panel never mounts → no badges available for assertion. This is an environment limitation, not a Faz-3 code defect.
